Massively improved polish and compatibility, with a few giant additions

Entire codebase refactor and workflow overhaul for much faster changes in the future

Improved Epic support
Improved SteamVR runtime support
Improved Controller support and fixes including for WMR/Reverb controllers
Improved logging and error reporting setup with auto log maker
Improved setup script to let you manually select runtime and auto selects default profile based on hardware
Improved crosshair logic to be more consistent. Guns can actually be used ADS now without a reticle
Improved scripted scenes so your arms and hands now appear only while the game is actually animating them, instead of hanging frozen in your view
Improved scripted scenes so they now go where they are meant to, instead of being steered by where you were looking
Improved scripted scenes so you can rotate freely during cutscenes, but the game will also point you in the right direction for important moments
Improved scripted scenes with immersive cursor hide
Improved many, many new customization options in the INI
Improved performance
Improved default INI settings for compatibility and comfort
Decoupled locomotion and aiming completely
Decoupled weapon and bone system
Disabled weapon sway for more accurate iron sights

Fixed health and plasmid HUD meters
Fixed cutscene black bars
Fixed multiple bugs in the binding INI configs
Fixed the crosshair showing when you are not holding anything
Fixed the screenshake/injected rotation during normal play
Fixed all(hopefully) UI elements now anchor to the game world
Fixed quest arrow position and scale
Fixed rotational slew when entering scripted event
Fixed inconsistent turn speed
Fixed pause and radial menus submitting both frames causing jutter in the background
Fixed desktop mirror to only submit one of the frames instead of two to remove jutter(best experience for recording though is SteamVRs display view)

Added uninstall script
Added manual weapon swing(Very early but big improvements are coming soon)
Added multiple different locomotion modes for a wide range
Added snap turn option
Added more binding options for swapping dpad layout and modifier keys
Added a real tracked second hand the hand that is not holding your weapon now follows your own controller instead of being hidden, and turns with it
Added the same for your free hand while holding a plasmid
Added live in-headset tuning for hand position and rotation, saved automatically
Added two hand weapon grip for weapons
Added haptic feedback in several areas
Added customizable tuning keys

Known Issues:
Degraded SteamVR performance after 30 minutes with VirtualDesktop on Meta headsets - Known issue with meta drivers and not something I can fix. If you have this problem, this can fix it for some people: https://github.com/webhead2oo9/VirtualDesktopSwitcher

Quest arrow is slightly coupled with the weapon rotation, but it resets back to the correct position quickly

Arm height is slightly too low and forward in some scripted events(just move forward for them a little bit lol)

Desktop mirror runs at about half the framerate of the headset. This is not an issue with performance and instead the way the game submits frames to the actual game window.

A lot of the work on the polish and mechanics have been in the early game so I cant test every feature on every part of the game, but hopefully my systems that have been built hold up in every area
